sentences.en: This financial audit also includes an evaluation of the company's assets.
sentences.zh: 这次财务审计还包括对公司资产的评估。

sentences.en: The audit team interviewed staff and did a walkthrough of the offices.
sentences.zh: 审计团队采访了员工并检查了办公室。

sentences.en: You will be in trouble if you become the target of a tax audit.
sentences.zh: 如果你成为税务审计的目标，你可能会遇到麻烦。
